name: NPM publisher
description: Walks a Node package through the npm publish flow. Never touches git.
about: Takes a Node package from where it is now to published on npm, one step at a time: auth check, pre-flight on package.json, a version bump you choose, the project's own lint, build and test scripts, a dry run you approve, then publish with a 2FA code you supply. It edits package.json and leaves the bump uncommitted; it never runs a git command that writes.
features: Check auth and package.json before you publish
Bump the version and run the project's own checks
Show the dry-run file list before anything ships
examplePrompt: Publish this package to npm. Bump the patch version first and show me what's in the tarball before it goes.
